hero.lede: I'm Max-Morrys. I help entrepreneurs and brands across French-speaking Africa exist online — by training them, and by building with them. From Dakar.

clients.eyebrow: They trusted me with their project

about.title: Douala, Abidjan, [Dakar.]
about.p1: I grew up in Douala, studied economics in Abidjan, then management and digital business in Dakar. I learned marketing by doing it: for SMEs, organisations, hospitals, churches.
about.p2: Today I train the people who want to make it their job, and with my studio I build the online presence of brands that want to count.
about.pShort: I learned marketing by doing it: for SMEs, organisations, hospitals, churches. Today I pass it on, and I build.

audiences.title: Three ways to work together.
audiences.lede: My path wasn't a straight line.
audiences.ledeStrong: I learned digital by practising it, and that's exactly what I pass on.
